## Open Anatomy Atlas

An open-source 3D atlas of the human body for teaching and learning, developed by the Cognition Lab.

**Use it online:** see the link in the repository description (GitHub Pages).

**Install on Linux:**
- `.deb` (Ubuntu, Debian): `sudo apt install ./open-anatomy-atlas-<version>-amd64.deb`
- AppImage: `chmod +x open-anatomy-atlas-<version>-x86_64.AppImage`, then run it (needs `libfuse2`; add `--no-sandbox` on Ubuntu 24.04 if it shows a sandbox error)

On first launch, open **Atlas data** to download the anatomy (BodyParts3D 4.3, Z-Anatomy or BodyParts3D 4.0).

See CHANGELOG.md for what is new, and NOTICE.md for the data licences.
